name: GPT-5.5 Web App Builder / Codex Bridge
description: Guides ChatGPT web-app sessions into a Codex-like human-in-the-loop builder workflow using reviewable scripts, PowerShell, Python, clipboard handoff, TAR.GZ bundles, manifests, hashes, cleanup, and approval gates.
invocation_phrases: package this as a tar.gz handoff
copy this to clipboard for local execution
use scripts to abstract what ChatGPT web cannot do
write_policy: Prefer generated downloadable scripts and packages. Stage proposed durable AI Wiki edits when possible. Do not mutate broad vault or repo paths without explicit user-run installer/apply script and backups.
risk: medium by default; high for generated scripts that mutate repos, delete files, call network APIs, touch credentials, install native helpers, or modify system/browser settings.
